close_reason: Fixed in rm8.68: added pub use pkix_path_builder to pkix-chain
description:
src/lib.rs:223 — `Error::PathBuild(pkix_path_builder::Error)` puts
`pkix_path_builder::Error` into pkix-chain's public surface. The
`From<pkix_path_builder::Error>` impl at src/lib.rs:292-296 makes the
type visible there too.

But pkix-chain does NOT re-export pkix-path-builder. Compare the other
upstream-error variants:

  - Error::Path(pkix_path::Error)         — `pub use pkix_path::{self, ...}` ✓
  - Error::Revocation(pkix_revocation::Error) — `pub use pkix_revocation::{self, ...}` ✓
  - Error::Identity(pkix_identity::IdentityError) — `pub use pkix_identity::{IdentityError, ...}` ✓
  - Error::Aia(pkix_aia::AiaError)        — `pub use pkix_aia::{AiaError, ...}` ✓
  - Error::PathBuild(pkix_path_builder::Error) — NO re-export of pkix_path_builder

Consequences for callers:

1. A caller matching `Err(Error::PathBuild(pkix_path_builder::Error::NoPathFound))`
   must add pkix-path-builder as a *direct* dependency in their own
   Cargo.toml, then pin its version to match pkix-chain's pinned version.
   The Cargo.lock will paper over the version mismatch some of the time;
   when it doesn't, you get \"the type `pkix_path_builder::Error` doesn't
   match\" compile errors that have no obvious fix from the caller's
   perspective.

2. The error variant cannot be programmatically distinguished without
   that direct dep. Callers who only want to log the error via
   `Display` are fine, but callers wanting to react to specific
   path-builder errors (e.g., \"retry on transient,\" \"give up on
   NoPathFound\") are forced into the direct-dep model.

Two reasonable fixes:

a) Add `pub use pkix_path_builder::{self};` to the re-export block,
   matching the existing pattern. Cheapest fix; commits to the same
   forever-coupling cost as the other re-exports (see the sibling
   finding on `pub use foo::{self, ...}`).

b) Wrap path-builder errors into a stable local enum in pkix-chain.
   More work, smaller forever surface, but means the From impl
   degrades information (e.g., \"PathBuild { kind: NoPathFound }\"
   instead of the upstream variant). Likely overkill.

Either is acceptable. Status quo (have the type in the surface, don't
re-export it) is not — it forces every caller into a coupling pkix-chain
hasn't acknowledged in its Cargo.toml or rustdoc.

Caller impact: anyone wanting AIA chain reassembly with structured error
handling.
title: Error::PathBuild exposes pkix_path_builder::Error without re-export
